description: Takımımız Arduino ve C# programlama dillerinde temel ve orta düzey bilgiye sahiptir. Arduino ile sensör, LED, buton ve LCD ekran kullanarak elektronik devreler kurabiliyoruz. C# ile masaüstü uygulamaları ve kullanıcı arayüzleri geliştirebiliyoruz. Ayrıca Arduino ile bilgisayar arasında seri haberleşme kurabiliyoruz. Problem çözme, araştırma ve takım çalışması becerilerimizi kullanarak yenilikçi projeler geliştirmeyi hedefliyoruz.
summary: In this project, players can design their own spacecraft as they wish or choose from existing, authentic spacecraft models to travel between planets. Throughout their journey, they earn points based on the soundness of the decisions they make when faced with sudden space-related challenges—such as meteor showers or technical malfunctions—and unlock achievements by completing special missions. The most significant innovation of our project lies in its integration of real-time data from NASA into the game universe, offering a realistic and interactive learning experience. Developed with the aid of artificial intelligence-driven tools, this simulation aims to make space exploration and scientific awareness accessible to all.
details:
Project Purpose and Function:
Our project is an interactive space simulation designed to offer players an engaging and immersive experience while providing foundational knowledge about planets and space science. In this simulation, players can design their own spacecraft from scratch or navigate using existing, realistic spacecraft models to travel between planets. Players earn points based on the decisions they make when encountering various challenges in space—such as meteor showers or technical malfunctions—and can unlock achievements by completing special missions.
NASA Data Integration:
A core component of our project is the integration of real-time data from NASA into the game universe. This allows players to explore the cosmos based on actual scientific data, providing an opportunity to discover the universe grounded in real-world information.
Tools, Technologies, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Usage:
During the development of our project, we actively utilized modern software tools and artificial intelligence (AI) assistants:
Scenario and Design: AI tools were employed to structure game mechanics, define customization options for spacecraft, and develop educational dialogue.
Coding and Prototyping: AI-powered coding assistants were used to develop mechanics for interplanetary travel and emergency scenarios; additionally, integrations with NASA APIs were tested.
Visuals and Optimization: We leveraged AI-driven visual generation tools and utilized AI for debugging and optimization processes. Why Is This Initiative Important and Innovative?
This project seamlessly blends entertainment with education to boost young people's interest in space science; it makes the field accessible through gamification based on actual NASA divisions and delivers an advanced prototype enhanced by rapid, AI-driven development.
